name: Drifblim
description: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target while crying out in a startling fashion.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target to deal damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user causes an explosion to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
